name: Unidentified B1 battle droid 4 (Malevolence)
description: A B1 battle droid was stationed on the Separatist Subjugator-class heavy cruiser Malevolence in 22 BBY. During the Battle of Abregado, the droid reported on the arrival of three Galactic Republic Venator-class Star Destroyers to Count Dooku, who ordered the droid to jam their transmissions.
